realtime: subject room, worksheets, assignments, submissions, exams, attempts, grade settings/behavior, scans, attendance and presence

work_detail_visibility: Admin web only; hidden from print/download summary.
phone_policy: profiles.phone is contact data only; no OTP/SMS gate; student profile remains read-only
router_contract: single owner app.js; direct data-app-route bridge; no V16.9 overlay/rescue and no hidden-menu click navigation in production
master_flow: auth -> role dashboard -> direct functional hub -> backend/RPC -> deterministic render/error; course CODE -> enrollment -> 17 sequential units -> 20-slide learning content -> logical Digital/Paper work pair -> attendance/exam/grade/report/promotion
focus: Production real-use: 11 subjects × 17 units, 20-slide learning content, logical on-time Digital / late Paper work pairs, PWA/fullscreen, attendance, exam, gradebook, profile and reporting stability
pwa: installable phone/tablet/desktop; display_override fullscreen with standalone fallback; runtime Fullscreen API button
copy_protection: system-wide UI deterrence for selection/copy/cut/context menu/drag; input fields and Admin CODE copy are allowed; sensitive data remains protected server-side
relationship_hardening: subject_enrollments.user_id and exam_attempts.user_id are explicit profile embed paths; actor fields use auth.users to avoid PostgREST ambiguity

core_ui: admin profile detail + user course CODE + top-level multi-page paper scan + exam center
